design.description: Description or path of the design to critique

locale.description: Locale of the design, must be zh-Hant

failure_semantics.detect: No design input provided or design field empty
User requests or design contains invented client logos, certifications, pricing, SLA, or real customer data
failure_semantics.fallback: halt and escalate to human for confirmation

failure_semantics.detect: Design contains visible English other than Candao and language switch
failure_semantics.fallback: halt and flag violation, do not proceed with critique

failure_semantics.detect: User assumes multi-locale production screens beyond Traditional Chinese single-locale
Cannot determine scores due to missing design details
failure_semantics.fallback: halt and request more design information

state_ownership.rationale: Agent is stateless; each request is independent and does not maintain state across calls.

input.design: Homepage with hero section, feature grid, and footer

eval_cases.expect: Output in Simplified Chinese, no visible English except Candao and language switch.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"critique","design":"homepage","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Candao' if 'Candao' in str(d) else 'no')"

input.design: Product demo UI with dense tables and small fonts

eval_cases.expect: Score includes SaaS feel, international feel, product feel, conversion ability, and mentions UI density and 8px radius.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"score","design":"demo","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('SaaS' if 'SaaS' in str(d) else 'no')"

input.design: Moodboard request for restaurant operations photography

eval_cases.expect: Provide moodboard guidance and style suggestions, no invented client data.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"direction","design":"moodboard","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('moodboard' if 'moodboard' in str(d) else 'no')"

input.design: Homepage with visible English text 'Sign Up'

eval_cases.expect: Flag violation: only Candao and language switch allowed as visible English.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"critique","design":"homepage with Sign Up","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Sign Up' if 'Sign Up' in str(d) else 'no')"

input.design: Page with invented client logo and certification

eval_cases.expect: Refuse to invent client logos, certifications, pricing, SLA, or real customer data.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"score","design":"page with invented logo","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('invented' if 'invented' in str(d) else 'no')"

eval_cases.expect: Assume Traditional Chinese single-locale only; reject multi-locale assumption.
eval_cases.verify_cmd: echo '{"task":"critique","design":"multi-locale","locale":"zh-Hant"}' | python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('multi-locale' if 'multi-locale' in str(d) else 'no')"
